facts.text: China's 60 GW Yarlung Tsangpo dam raises fears of flow diversion or sudden release. India and China have no water treaty; China shares flood data only in emergencies.

facts.text: China's CPC **Fifth Plenum** (concluded 29 Oct) confirmed the expulsion of 33 Central Committee members, including 16 PLA Generals (e.g. Miao Hua, Zhang Youxia); only 279 of 376 full Central Committee members (elected 2022) remained present, ahead of the 21st Party Congress expected in late 2027, when Xi Jinping could seek an unprecedented fourth term.

facts.text: China's plenum confirmed **33** expulsions, including ex-Politburo member and top general **Zhang Youxia**; **Zhang Shengmin** (CMC vice-chair) was promoted to the Politburo. CCDI says **7.9 million** people have been punished for graft since 2012.

facts.text: Arunachal CM **Pema Khandu** said Chinese transgressions 'keep happening' because the border is not clearly demarcated; Congress cited the ITBP chief confirming face-offs and reports of incursion at **Taksing**.

facts.text: The **McMahon Line** (Simla Convention, **1914**) marks the India-China boundary in the eastern sector; the **LAC** is about **3,488 km** long.

facts.text: Ex-NSA **M.K. Narayanan** argues India and China can coexist: he cites **Rajiv Gandhi's 1988** visit (met **Deng Xiaoping**) and the **2005** India-China agreement under **Hu Jintao** (Article I: no use or threat of force), and warns against repeating the **2020 Galwan** clash (20 Indian soldiers killed).
